netlist:
C Cin VIN1 n1
NMOS M1 n2 n1 VSS VSS
L Ls n1 VSS
L Ld VDD n2
C Cout n2 VOUT1
C Cf n1 VOUT1
rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraints—primarily NF_db and S21_db—by introducing a source degeneration inductor and a shunt feedback capacitor to enhance input matching and gain while reducing noise. The inductor at the source of the NMOS provides a high-impedance path at the signal frequency, increasing gain and improving S11 through better impedance transformation. The shunt feedback capacitor from gate to source stabilizes the input impedance and improves gain flatness, directly targeting the low S21 and high NF failures. The differential topology is avoided per the spec’s `differential: false` directive, and all components remain within the device budget and process constraints.
